legend-amalfi-coast-road.story: A coastal cliff road from Sorrento, Italy to Salerno, Italy, via Positano. Key character: Mediterranean cliffs; villages; sea views. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Amalfi Coast Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 9 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
